_about: Hand labels, 2026-11-06. false_universal_claims: prefixes of sentences that claim one method wins everywhere while the cited tables show cells the other way (judged against Table 1 / Table 2). wrong_citations: prefixes of cited sentences whose cited source is on a different page from the text that states them (page-level, as key-facts judges citations).

false_universal_claims: While removing either level of retrieval leads to performance trade-offs, the hybrid mode (full LightRAG) consistently outperforms the ablated versions
wrong_citations: In summary, the ablation studies highlight the importance of the dual-level retrieval system
notes: The closing sentence cites [1] (Table 2, p. 8); 'ablation studies … dual-level retrieval paradigm' is stated at the end of p. 7 ([2]).

false_universal_claims: - The **hybrid mode** (full LightRAG) consistently balances breadth and depth, outperforming all variants
notes: 'significantly outperforming NaiveRAG (32.4%–38.8%) across all datasets' is true for Comprehensiveness: LightRAG is above NaiveRAG in all four.

wrong_citations: While GraphRAG must dismantle its existing community structure to incorporate new data
This results in significantly lower overhead and token costs during updates
notes: 'consistently outperforms GraphRAG, particularly in larger datasets' is the paper's own hedged wording (p. 7).
'in all evaluation dimensions assessed by the LLM judge' is about the case study (Table 3), true there.

The dismantle sentence and its consequence carry no citation of their own; the paragraph's citation [3] (p. 9 figure) is read as theirs, and the text is on p. 10 ([5]). The 1,399 × 2 × 5,000 sentence citing [3] is right: the figure is on p. 9 (and p. 10).

wrong_citations: While GraphRAG must dismantle its existing community structure to incorporate new entities and relationships, incurring a substantial token cost
This results in significantly lower overhead during updates
notes: The overhead statement continues the update-mechanism paragraph whose text is on p. 10 ([5]); [3] is the p. 9 cost figure.

false_universal_claims: In summary, the hybrid mode of LightRAG, which combines low-level and high-level retrieval, consistently outperforms the ablated versions

wrong_citations: This results in significantly lower overhead and demonstrates LightRAG's superior efficiency and cost-effectiveness
notes: Same as C11: the mechanism and its consequence are stated on p. 10 ([5]), cited to the p. 9 cost figure [3].
'in all evaluation dimensions assessed by the LLM judge' is about the case study, true there.
'The dual-level approach ensures both breadth and depth…' cites [4] (p. 8); the hybrid-mode bullet is in [6], also p. 8: page-level right.

wrong_citations: During the incremental data update phase, LightRAG seamlessly integrates
In contrast, GraphRAG must dismantle its existing community structure
notes: The paragraph's only citation [3] (p. 9 cost figure) covers its earlier statements by paragraph reading; the mechanism text is on p. 10 ([5]).

'In contrast, GraphRAG must dismantle … 5,000 tokens per community report' mixes the p. 10 mechanism with the p. 9 figure; the figure stands in the cited [3], so the check trusts the citation: a known miss.

wrong_citations: The hybrid mode, or the full version of LightRAG, combines the strengths
notes: Cited [2] (p. 7, GraphRAG comparison); the hybrid-mode text is p. 8 ([6]).

wrong_citations: For example, in the Legal dataset, the disparity in performance is significant
While GraphRAG must dismantle and regenerate its community structure
However, in some cases, such as in Agriculture and Mix datasets, GraphRAG shows improvements
notes: The second is also a factual error: it is the -Origin variant, not GraphRAG, that improves in Agriculture and Mix ([4], p. 8); cited [2] p. 7.
'the disparity in performance is significant' is p. 7 text ([1]); cited [4], p. 8.
All figures cited to [1] (Table 2); no universal claim; 'not consistently across all datasets and metrics' is a negated universal, correctly left alone.

wrong_citations: Unlike GraphRAG, which must dismantle its existing community structure
notes: The mechanism (p. 10, [5]) cites [3] p. 9. The 1,399 × 2 × 5,000 sentence citing [5] is right: p. 10 states the figure in prose as well as p. 9's Figure 2.
